standard_prerequisites.name: The vanishing results for the modular sheaves at infinite level
standard_prerequisites.reference: The vanishing results for the modular sheaves at infinite level, the inverse system of trace maps between the levels, and the comparison of the cohomology with its extension of scalars.
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies background that the delivered proof uses. The entry is declared as a dependency; it is not re-proved on the card, and the load-bearing steps of the counted statement are carried out inside the delivered span.

core_obligations: With the integral perfectoid model2060 and finite-level local duality900000183 retained as priors, the author must control the nonstationary cuspidal sheaves on the tower, use perfectoid Frobenius to shift the critical weights1/2 into the finite-level vanishing range, and pass through the p-adic/direct limits without losing the integral lattice. The normalized dualizing traces then identify the weak topological dual with the inverse limit of modular forms, compatibly with the cyclotomic-semilinear GL2(Qp) action, and specialize to completed cohomology. These coupled Frobenius, cusp, trace and topological-duality constructions are retained as one H2 author framework; the existing model/localization/lci dualizing lemmas are not new counts.
proof_roadmap: Step 1: reduce to the cyclotomic case and replace the sheaf by its scalar extension, using that the cohomology commutes with the extension of scalars. Step 2: dualise the cohomology and rewrite the dual in terms of the trace maps of the inverse system. Step 3: identify the resulting inverse limit with the space of cuspidal modular forms of the stated weight.
